items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Traveled all to the state of Florida with Celestan. I stayed about four years with him... Well the time I was playing with Celestan...

ctx.x: Traveled all to the state of Florida with Celestan. I stayed about four years with him and when I came back, I joined D. Vathomies Band.
Yeah, about when was that when you were with Celestan?
